# Czapp

> > Czapp delivers expert commodity market analysis and insights across agriculture, shipping, fertilizers, and global trade dynamics.

Czapp provides professional market intelligence for commodity traders and agricultural stakeholders, featuring analysis from industry experts like Peter Sand, Stephen Geldart, and specialists covering fertilizers, sugar, grains, and freight markets. The platform tracks critical supply chain trends across major markets including China, Brazil, India, and the US, with particular focus on food security, shipping rates, and geopolitical impacts on commodity flows.

## Key Topics

- Commodity trading and market analysis
- Food security and agricultural sustainability
- Container shipping and freight rates
- Dry bulk shipping and Baltic Index
- Fertilizer markets (urea, potash, DAP)
- Sugar market analysis and trade flows
- Chinese imports and market dominance
- Brazilian Real currency impacts
- COVID-19 pandemic effects on commodities
- Russia-Ukraine conflict trade disruptions
- Grain markets (wheat, corn, soybeans)
- Iron ore and coal shipping
- US East Coast trade routes
- India and Brazil agricultural exports

## Shipping & Freight Analysis

- [Chinese Imports to Occupy 50% of Dry Bulk Market Share in 2021](https://www.czapp.com/analyst-insights/chinese-imports-to-occupy-50-of-dry-bulk-market-share-in-2021): BIMCO's Peter Sand analyzes China's 50% dry bulk market share dominance
- [SE Asia-US E Coast Spot Container Rates Drop 13.8% Jan 1-May 31](https://www.czapp.com/analyst-insights/se-asia-us-e-coast-spot-container-rates-drop-13-8-jan-1-may-31): Xeneta analyst tracks 13.8% container rate decline on SE Asia-US route
- [Freight Update – Baltic Index Collapses](https://www.czapp.com/analyst-insights/freight-update-baltic-index-collapses): Brittain and Geldart analyze Baltic Dry Index collapse and shipping rates
- [Far East-US E Coast Container Capacity Grows 18.9% on Year](https://www.czapp.com/analyst-insights/far-east-us-e-coast-container-capacity-grows-18-9-on-year): Peter Sand reports 18.9% container capacity growth on Far East-US route
